title: Cy Twombly - Allusions, Bay of Naples (from the collection of Donald Baechler)
medium: Color offset lithograph and photo lithograph on wove paper

said.q: This print served as the exhibition advertisement for the second show, “Allusions (Bay of Napoli),” of works on paper referencing Orpheus, Dionysus and Narcissus.

events.q: Published by Edizioni Lucio Amelio, Galeria Lucio Amelio, Naples, with blind stamp

events.n: where the portrait photograph was taken; photographer presumably Lucio Amelio
events.q: gazing out across the Bay of Naples from the Villa Comunale

in whose gallery Twombly staged back-to-back shows in the winter of 1974-75.
This print served as the exhibition advertisement for the second show, “Allusions (Bay of Napoli),” of works on paper referencing Orpheus, Dionysus and Narcissus.
Acquired from the collection of artist Donald Baechler

events.t: Landscapes, Cityscapes, Waterscapes and Skyscapes: paintings, works on paper and prints
